description: This file contains functions and enums for loading and retrieving model configurations, including fetching from URLs or local files, and filtering models by category and name.

methods.name: getModelsJSONPath
methods.description: Determines the path to the models.json file by checking predefined locations.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: getRawModelFile
methods.description: Loads the raw model data from a URL or local file, with fallback to default models.json.

methods.name: getModelConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a specific model configuration by category and name.

methods.name: getModelConfigByModelName
methods.description: Exports a function to get model configuration by category, provider, and name.

methods.name: getSpecificModelFromCategory
methods.description: Finds a specific model within a category based on provider and name.

methods.name: getModels
methods.description: Retrieves models for a given category and name.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves regions for a given model category and name.
